newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK ASSETS RISE IN FEBRUARY.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK ASSETS RISE IN FEBRUARY.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Wednesday that its total assets rose during the month of February to 3.555 billion litas from 3.532 billion litas.
The bank also said in a balance sheet of its analytical accounts that its foreign assets rose by 0.2 percent in the same period, from 3.180 billion litas to 3.188 billion litas.
The bank said that its claims on the private sector fell 2.1 percent in February to 9.5 million litas from 9.7 million litas.
Its claims on deposit money in banks rose by 7.2 percent to 144.7 million litas from 135.0 million litas.
It said that its other assets rose by three percent to 213.1 million litas from 206.9 million litas.
